title: Sensitivity analysis with fect and HonestDiDFEct
text: example Hainmueller Hangartner (2019), study effect indirect versus direct democracy naturalization rates Swiss municipalities. data come fect hh2019. outcome nat_rate_ord naturalization rate, effects percentage points. fect, s = 1 first treated period s = 0 last untreated one. placebo.period = c(-2, 0) holds s = -2, -1 0. fect imputes untreated outcome periods way treatment. first three rows placebo coefficients, last line gives changes . number treated units count drops s = 4. tutorial uses s = 1 4.
code: library(fect) data(hh2019) out <- fect(nat_rate_ord ~ indirect, data = hh2019, index = c("bfs", "year"),             method = "fe", se = TRUE,             placeboTest = TRUE, placebo.period = c(-2, 0),             parallel = FALSE, seed = 1234) round(out$est.att[as.character(-2:6), c("ATT", "S.E.", "count")], 3) #>       ATT  S.E. count #> -2 -0.047 0.262   503 #> -1  0.183 0.264   503 #> 0   0.254 0.276   503 #> 1   0.923 0.272   503 #> 2   1.929 0.353   414 #> 3   2.149 0.438   346 #> 4   1.384 0.346   341 #> 5   1.478 0.451   153 #> 6   3.063 0.683   132 round(diff(out$est.att[as.character(-2:0), "ATT"]), 3) #>    -1     0  #> 0.230 0.071

title: Sensitivity analysis with fect and HonestDiDFEct

Delta column shows DeltaRM DeltaSD. Always pass post.periods, default fails. must start 1 gaps. Mbarvec Mvec hold values Mbar M average effect, periodMbarvec periodMvec hold values period. set period vector NULL, also drops results average effect. fit call take minutes. value post-treatment period adds run time.

code: # Placebo periods -2, -1 and 0, then post periods 1 to 4. fect_sens() makes this   # call for you on a fect() run with placeboTest = TRUE.   betahat <- c("-2" = 0.02, "-1" = -0.01, "0" = 0.01,                "1" = 0.08, "2" = 0.10, "3" = 0.09, "4" = 0.12)   sigma   <- 0.0004 * 0.5^abs(outer(1:7, 1:7, "-")) + 0.0001   constructOriginalCS(betahat, sigma, numPrePeriods = 3, numPostPeriods = 4,                       l_vec = rep(0.25, 4)) #> # A tibble: 1 × 4 #>   lb[,1] ub[,1] method   Delta #>    <dbl>  <dbl> <chr>    <lgl> #> 1 0.0632  0.132 Original NA
